name: Facebook Pages (Graph API)
summary: Facebook Pages you manage through Meta's Graph API: Page details, the Page feed, and publishing posts and photos.

api_version.description: Graph API version. Meta retires old versions about two years after release.

token.description: A Page access token (or a system-user token) from your Meta app, with the Pages permissions the call needs (Meta for Developers > your app > Graph API Explorer)

notes: Most Page calls need a Page access token, obtained by exchanging a user token; the Pages a user manages come from user.accounts.
Reading Page content and publishing need Meta App Review for the pages_* permissions.
Lists page with paging.cursors.after; follow paging.next when present.
Rate limits are per Page: error 80001 means too many calls, wait and retry.

endpoints.name: Get a Page
endpoints.summary: Profile and audience fields of a Facebook Page.

fields.description: Comma-separated: id, name, username, about, category, link, website, fan_count, followers_count, is_published, instagram_business_account, ...

notes: Fields that can carry user data need a Page access token; the instagram_business_account field needs a user token.

endpoints.name: List a Page's posts
endpoints.summary: The Page's feed: its own posts, visitor posts and public posts that tag it.

fields.description: Comma-separated post fields, e.g. id, message, created_time, permalink_url, attachments.

notes: Needs a Page access token and pages_read_engagement plus pages_read_user_content.
Returns roughly 600 published, ranked posts a year; expired posts are gone. Reels come from the VideoReels edge.

endpoints.name: Publish a post to a Page
endpoints.summary: A text and/or link post, published now or scheduled.

message.description: Post text. Send message or link.

published.description: false creates an unpublished (draft or scheduled) post.

scheduled_publish_time.description: Unix time between 10 minutes and 75 days ahead; with published=false.

notes: Publishes publicly as the Page. Needs a Page access token from a user who can create content, with pages_manage_posts.

endpoints.name: Publish a photo to a Page
endpoints.summary: Uploads a photo from a public URL.

url.description: Public URL of the image (max 4 MB).

published.description: Default true; false uploads without publishing.

notes: Publishes publicly unless published=false (unpublished photos are deleted after about 24 hours). Needs a Page access token and pages_manage_posts.

endpoints.name: List the Pages a user manages
endpoints.summary: Pages the token's user owns or has a role on, with the user's tasks on each.

fields.description: Comma-separated Page fields, e.g. id, name, tasks.
